# i2-old-vaults

Old-style (Lab Kit 1.4.x) planning notes for the planned-dates (I2) existing-vault test: no `scheduled` property anywhere.
Fixed dates used by tests: the week of Monday 2026-10-19 (Wed 2026-10-21, Sat 2026-10-24, Mon 2026-10-26).

- `vault/00 Planning/To-dos/`: one note per state (Backlog, Mon-Fri with and without `planned`, rolled, done with and without `done_on`, `day: Done`, no `kind`, a `day` typo, weekend, due only, subtasks with `after`, meeting-flagged).
- `devices/laptop` and `devices/phone`: the same note names with the states two synced devices leave (a copy not yet through the sync).
- `vault/` kept kit notes: Project hub (Alpha), Daily note, Weekly review, To-do board.base, plus `Own queries.md` (own Dataview on `day`).
